change_summary: Restricted K-loop bounds in matmul_tril_kernel to range(k_lo, k_hi) where k_lo = col_start // BLOCK_K (skips zero-B K-blocks since B is lower-triangular) and k_hi = tl.cdiv(tl.minimum(K, row_start + BLOCK_M), BLOCK_K) (skips zero-A K-blocks since A is lower-triangular), eliminating ~50% of K-loop iterations.
